items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, he worked with all the different things. ... Not with Bob Lyons. I mean Kid Old and Frankie Deuce because Bob Lyons plays himself.

ctx.x: He worked with Kid Old, he worked with Bob Lyons. Oh, he worked with all the different things.
Did Pops Foster work with Bob Lyons? Hmm? Pops Foster. Well, what did he play with Bob Lyons?
Oh, he worked with all the different things.
